invariants.rule: Focus, active row/node, selected record, multi-selection membership, expansion and opened record remain distinct UI states.
Single click selects without opening; double-click/Enter open the active eligible record; nested controls never additionally open the row.
Scroll input belongs to the nearest legitimate hovered/focused/gesture-origin scroll surface and never changes selection, accepts a suggestion, opens a record, confirms a hold or submits a command.
Autocomplete results are bounded/query-scoped; stale responses cannot replace current results; typed text/similarity never creates an entity or relationship.
Responsive reflow preserves all material facts, warnings, evidence, actions, validation, labels, order, keyboard navigation and working-copy state.
A deliberate hold lasts one continuous three exact elapsed seconds on a monotonic source and completion only requests a command; domain validation still decides acceptance.
Device Reference promotion always uses the deliberate-hold tier and preserves original operational Device Reference identity after successful regularization.
Unsaved working copy, accepted revision and persistent domain Draft state are never conflated; unsaved state cannot influence authoritative projections.
Stale identity/evidence/lifecycle edits never resolve through last-write-wins; conflicts require reviewed reapplication against current revision.
Undo is available only while the exact inverse remains valid/bounded/safe; accepted evidence/lifecycle uses owning-domain history-preserving commands instead.
Relationship/context previews never authorize silent entity merge or duplicate authoritative facts across domains.
Canonical Communication content exists once under HLD-10 even when displayed from multiple workbenches; drafts remain separate from sent evidence.
Unavailable predictable commands expose blocker/remediation when useful; a known-invalid command is not enabled merely to fail later.
Bulk preflight partitions every selected target explicitly; no incompatible/stale target is silently skipped or coerced.
Skin/appearance/motion choices cannot alter information architecture, workflow, command semantics, status meaning, confirmation friction or accessibility.
State/warnings never depend on color, motion, position or a single sensory channel alone; keyboard/pointer/touch preserve equivalent domain results.

acceptance_hooks: bulk explicit partitions and per-target results
